sentences.sentence: She quotes an Austrian banker as saying: “I always find it easier to do business [in English] with partners from Greece or Russia or Denmark.
sentences.translation: 她引用了一位奥地利银行家的话称：“我总是发现，（用英语）和希腊、俄罗斯或丹麦人做生意更容易一些。

sentences.sentence: The election of Mary Robinson in 1990 was a watershed in Irish politics.

sentences.sentence: Whether you are a carpenter or a therapist, a homemaker or a professor, it makes no difference.
sentences.translation: 不论你是一个木匠或是一个治疗师，一个家庭主妇还是教授，这都没有区别。

sentences.sentence: My mother was a mother, homemaker.… I think my mother influenced me as far as my love for reading.
sentences.translation: 我母亲就是一位母亲，家庭主妇……我想我母亲对我的影响很大，甚至包括我对阅读的喜爱。

sentences.sentence: “I would not have wanted to live in my parents’ or grandparents’ time,” said Mrs. Peeples, a full-time homemaker.
sentences.translation: 皮尔普斯太太现在是个全职主妇。 她说：“我不会继续活在我父母或祖父母那个时代了。

sentences.sentence: ...this vast chronicle of Napoleonic times.

sentences.sentence: As chemical precursors stream onto the surface of a rolling metal or plastic substrate, they react with one another to form a network of nanoparticles.
sentences.translation: 各化学母质流向滚动中的金属或塑料基片的表面，他们互相作用，形成一层纳米级微粒网状结构。

sentences.sentence: Fundamentally, these paradigms can be (and are) built on top of a substrate of threads and locks, but they create higher level abstractions that push much of that complexity down.
sentences.translation: 从根本上讲，这些范例可以（且是）构建于线程和锁的基底之上，但是它们创建降低复杂度的更高的抽象级别。

sentences.sentence: This means that a file system would serve as a reasonable substrate for a synchronization database.
sentences.translation: 这意味着文件系统作为同步数据库的底层支持是合情合理的。

sentences.sentence: Without sustenance, the animals will soon die.
sentences.translation: 没有食物，动物很快就会死亡。

sentences.translation: 马铃薯是他们唯一的食物。

sentences.sentence: She received a small legacy from her aunt.

sentences.sentence: You said in your address that "developing excellence is a slow, painstaking process".
sentences.translation: 你在你的致词中说“发展卓越性是一个缓慢艰苦的过程”。

sentences.sentence: In order to transform their environment, he drew up the project with painstaking accuracy.
sentences.translation: 为了改造环境， 他苦心孤诣地制订了这个计划。

translations.translation: 没有自信的, 不确定的

sentences.sentence: Chris seemed nervous and unsure of herself.
sentences.translation: 克丽丝显得紧张，没有自信。

sentences.sentence: Could there have been a really large dam that caused a deep lake in both Zharu and the main valleys and is older than the loess deposits?
sentences.translation: 这儿有可能有一个真正巨大的大坝，导致扎如和主峡谷之间的深湖，并且时间比黄土沉积物还久远吗？

sentences.sentence: Then something strange happened: The loess in the terraces wasn’t on top of crushed rock anymore — it was on top of very finely laminated clay-rich sediments.
sentences.translation: 然后一些很奇怪的事儿发生了： 梯田里的黄土不再在碎岩石上- 在非常完美层压的黏土丰富的沉积物上。

sentences.sentence: With these layers downloaded, you can combine them with the base reflectivity image to produce a more easily readable image map.
sentences.translation: 下载了这些图层之后，您可以把它们与基本反射率图像结合起来生成更易于阅读的图像地图。

sentences.sentence: Using a model that simulates how light, water, and air interact, Seitz found that microbubbles could double the reflectivity of water at a concentration of only one part per million by volume.
sentences.translation: 塞茨利用一个模型模仿了光、水和空气是如何产生相互作用的，他发现：按体积计算，密度仅为百万分之一时，微型气泡可以使水的反射率加倍。

sentences.sentence: Do not include the radar base reflectivity image as it can make precise area location more difficult.
sentences.translation: 请勿包括雷达基本反射率图像，因为它可能会使精确定位地区变得更困难。

translations.translation: 使戒除(或放弃)习惯,使不习惯

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 317 单元

premiere
音标：英 /'premɪeə/  美 /prɪ'mɪr/
v. 初次公演
n. 初次的演出
adj. 杰出的
例句：The documentary premiered at the Jerusalem Film Festival.
那部记录片在耶路撒冷电影节上首映。
例句：Four astronauts visited for last week's premiere of the movie Space Station.
四位宇航员到场参加了上个星期举行的电影《空间站》的首映式。

screening
音标：英 /'skriːnɪŋ/  美 /'skrinɪŋ/
n. 放映
v. 遮蔽,筛选
短语：screening test — 筛选试验；屏蔽试验
短语：screening process — 筛选工序；过虑程式
短语：silk screening — 丝印；丝幕法；丝网漏印法
短语：window screening — 窗纱
短语：screening machine — 筛分机；筛选机
短语：screening effect — 屏蔽效应
短语：health screening — 健康检查；健康普查；卫生局的筛选
短语：preliminary screening — 初步筛选
短语：screening experiment — 筛选实验；屏蔽实验
短语：screening agent — 掩蔽剂；遮蔽剂
短语：genetic screening — 基因筛检；遗传筛查
短语：screening procedure — 甄别程序；筛选步骤
短语：coarse screening — 粗筛选
例句：a screening of Spielberg’s new movie
斯皮尔伯格的新片放映
例句：Most of the road behind the hotel was screened by an apartment block.
旅馆后面那条路的大部分都被一排公寓楼挡住了。

exemplary
音标：英 /ɪg'zemplərɪ; eg-/  美 /ɪɡ'zɛmpləri/
adj. 典范的,惩戒性的
短语：exemplary damages — [律]惩罚性的损害赔偿
例句：a company with an exemplary record on environmental issues
在处理环境问题方面可作为楷模的公司

Austrian
音标：美 /'ɔstriən/
n. 奥地利人
adj. 奥地利的, 奥地利人的
例句：When I began to cough, I blamed it on the Austrian cigarettes.
当我开始咳嗽时，我把这事怪在抽奥地利的香烟上。
例句：Austrian euro coins have a unique design for each denomination, with a common theme for each of the three series of coins.
奥地利的欧元硬币对于每个货币的命名有着唯一的设计，三个系列的硬币有着共同的设计主题。
例句：She quotes an Austrian banker as saying: “I always find it easier to do business [in English] with partners from Greece or Russia or Denmark.
她引用了一位奥地利银行家的话称：“我总是发现，（用英语）和希腊、俄罗斯或丹麦人做生意更容易一些。

watershed
音标：英 /'wɔːtəʃed/  美 /'wɔtɚʃɛd/
n. 分水岭
短语：watershed management — 流域管理
短语：watershed area — 分水岭地区；分水界域；集水面积
例句：The election of Mary Robinson in 1990 was a watershed in Irish politics.
1990年玛丽·鲁滨逊的当选是爱尔兰政治的分水岭。

periodization
n. (历史等的)时期(或时代)划分

homemaker
音标：英 /'həʊmmeɪkə(r)/  美 /'hommekɚ/
n. 主妇
例句：Whether you are a carpenter or a therapist, a homemaker or a professor, it makes no difference.
不论你是一个木匠或是一个治疗师，一个家庭主妇还是教授，这都没有区别。
例句：My mother was a mother, homemaker.… I think my mother influenced me as far as my love for reading.
我母亲就是一位母亲，家庭主妇……我想我母亲对我的影响很大，甚至包括我对阅读的喜爱。
例句：“I would not have wanted to live in my parents’ or grandparents’ time,” said Mrs. Peeples, a full-time homemaker.
皮尔普斯太太现在是个全职主妇。 她说：“我不会继续活在我父母或祖父母那个时代了。

chronicle
音标：英 /'krɒnɪk(ə)l/  美 /'krɑnɪkl/
n. 编年史
v. 编入编年史
例句：...this vast chronicle of Napoleonic times.
…这本关于拿破仑时期的大部头编年史。

substrate
音标：英 /'sʌbstreɪt/  美 /'sʌbstret/
n. （土地）底层,基础
短语：glass substrate — 玻璃衬底
短语：substrate material — 基材
短语：silicon substrate — 硅衬底
短语：ceramic substrate — 陶瓷；陶瓷基片；陶瓷衬底
短语：substrate bias — 衬底偏置
例句：As chemical precursors stream onto the surface of a rolling metal or plastic substrate, they react with one another to form a network of nanoparticles.
各化学母质流向滚动中的金属或塑料基片的表面，他们互相作用，形成一层纳米级微粒网状结构。
例句：Fundamentally, these paradigms can be (and are) built on top of a substrate of threads and locks, but they create higher level abstractions that push much of that complexity down.
从根本上讲，这些范例可以（且是）构建于线程和锁的基底之上，但是它们创建降低复杂度的更高的抽象级别。
例句：This means that a file system would serve as a reasonable substrate for a synchronization database.
这意味着文件系统作为同步数据库的底层支持是合情合理的。

sustenance
音标：英 /'sʌst(ə)nəns; -tɪn-/  美 /'sʌstənəns/
n. 食物, 生计, (受)支持
例句：Without sustenance, the animals will soon die.
没有食物，动物很快就会死亡。
例句：Potatoes were their only means of sustenance.
马铃薯是他们唯一的食物。

charitable
音标：英 /'tʃærɪtəb(ə)l/  美 /'tʃærətəbl/
adj. 慈善事业的,慷慨的,仁慈的
短语：charitable foundation — 慈善基金，慈善机构
短语：charitable donation — 慈善捐款
例句：charitable groups
慈善团体
例句：a charitable donation
慈善捐赠

tremendously
音标：英 /tri'mendəsli/  美 /trɪ'mɛndəsli/
adv. 非常地,可怕地,惊人地

outlook
音标：英 /'aʊtlʊk/  美 /'aʊtlʊk/
n. 景色, 展望
短语：outlook on — 对…的看法；对…眺望
短语：world outlook — 世界观
短语：outlook for — …的前途；…的远景
短语：outlook on life — 人生观
短语：market outlook — 市场前景；市场展望
短语：economic outlook — 经济前景
短语：mental outlook — n. 精神境界，精神面貌
短语：positive outlook — 乐观看法
短语：optimistic outlook — 乐观的前景
短语：microsoft outlook — 个人邮件及资讯管理软件
短语：on the outlook for — ◎注视着
例句：a very pleasing outlook from the bedroom window
从卧室窗户看出去的宜人景色

perceptive
音标：英 /pə'septɪv/  美 /pɚ'sɛptɪv/
adj. 感知的,知觉的
例句：a perceptive young man
一个观察敏锐的年轻人

legacy
音标：英 /'legəsɪ/  美 /'lɛgəsi/
n. 遗赠(物), 遗产
短语：legacy system — 遗留系统
例句：She received a small legacy from her aunt.
她从姨妈那里继承了一小笔遗产。

painstaking
音标：英 /'peɪnzteɪkɪŋ/  美 /'penztekɪŋ/
n. 辛苦
adj. 辛苦的, 辛勤的
例句：You said in your address that "developing excellence is a slow, painstaking process".
你在你的致词中说“发展卓越性是一个缓慢艰苦的过程”。
例句：In order to transform their environment, he drew up the project with painstaking accuracy.
为了改造环境， 他苦心孤诣地制订了这个计划。

unsure
音标：英 /ʌn'ʃʊə/  美 /,ʌn'ʃʊr/
adj. 没有自信的, 不确定的
例句：Chris seemed nervous and unsure of herself.
克丽丝显得紧张，没有自信。

loess
音标：英 /'ləʊɪs; lɜːs/  美 /'loɪs/
n. 黄土
短语：loess plateau — 黄土高原
例句：Could there have been a really large dam that caused a deep lake in both Zharu and the main valleys and is older than the loess deposits?
这儿有可能有一个真正巨大的大坝，导致扎如和主峡谷之间的深湖，并且时间比黄土沉积物还久远吗？
例句：Then something strange happened: The loess in the terraces wasn’t on top of crushed rock anymore — it was on top of very finely laminated clay-rich sediments.
然后一些很奇怪的事儿发生了： 梯田里的黄土不再在碎岩石上- 在非常完美层压的黏土丰富的沉积物上。

reflectivity
n. 反射率
例句：With these layers downloaded, you can combine them with the base reflectivity image to produce a more easily readable image map.
下载了这些图层之后，您可以把它们与基本反射率图像结合起来生成更易于阅读的图像地图。
例句：Using a model that simulates how light, water, and air interact, Seitz found that microbubbles could double the reflectivity of water at a concentration of only one part per million by volume.
塞茨利用一个模型模仿了光、水和空气是如何产生相互作用的，他发现：按体积计算，密度仅为百万分之一时，微型气泡可以使水的反射率加倍。
例句：Do not include the radar base reflectivity image as it can make precise area location more difficult.
请勿包括雷达基本反射率图像，因为它可能会使精确定位地区变得更困难。

dishabituate
音标：英 /,dɪshə'bɪtjʊeɪt/
vt. 使戒除(或放弃)习惯,使不习惯
